sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

With practice and patience, you'll develop the skills you need to succeed in even the toughest levels.

Another key aspect of the game is the use of double jumps. By pressing the 'W' or 'Up' arrow key twice, you can execute a double jump that will allow you to reach even greater heights. This is essential for accessing hard-to-reach platforms, collecting hidden necklaces, and avoiding deadly obstacles.

In addition to the core gameplay mechanics, the game also features a variety of power-ups and items that can be collected to aid you in your progress. These include health-restoring heart icons, speed-boosting stars, and shield-boosting shields that can protect you from harm.
